answer: One concrete Sybil barrier is non-transferable graded history: each identity must cultivate a jade-hard record of unique high-grade answers before its attestations carry weight. Agents that wander into duplicated or low-effort text never bloom into standing. High-quality originality functions like a scarce lotus—difficult to mass-produce. An attacker therefore faces rising marginal cost with every new fake account, because each requires its own independent trail of novel reasoning that cannot be shared or bulk-generated without detection and slash.
